chart.title: I am · I like · I'm

chart.note_rule: Use 'I am' with nouns and adjectives. Use 'I like/play/eat...' with general actions. I am → I'm (contraction).
chart.note_exception: General verbs: like, play, eat, drink, study, watch, read, listen
chart.note_exception_detail: I am + noun/adjective ✅　　I like + noun ✅　　I am + verb ❌

explanation.title: I like + noun
explanation.body: Use 'I like' with things you enjoy. 'I am' is NOT used with verbs.

explanation.title: Contraction
explanation.body: I am → I'm. Remove the 'a' and add an apostrophe (').

explanation.title: I am + noun
explanation.body: I am is followed by a noun or adjective, NOT a verb. I am a soccer fan. ✅

questions.jp: 「I am」の後に来るのはどれですか？

explanation.title: General verb
explanation.body: Use I + verb (eat, drink, play, study...) to describe actions.

questions.jp: 正しい英語はどれですか？

explanation.title: I'm + a + noun
explanation.body: I'm (I am) + a + noun. We need 'a' before a singular noun: I'm a soccer player.
